body:
## Why
Two stores mean every verb is written twice (`docs/local-first.md` §1 item 9, §7 second paragraph, ADR-006 consequences).

## What
1. Delete `src/store/github.js`, the `tasks.js`/`lock.js` shims, `src/projects.js` (the Projects mirror returns with the bridge; keep its pure `planSync` in `src/bridge/` as a stub file with a note if you prefer, or delete it and say so), `init --store github`, `heartbeat: comment` and `HEARTBEAT_MODES`, `KB_LOCK_REF` and `lock_sha` (the skill, `protocol.md`, `src/context.js`), the run-comment serialisers in `src/model.js` that nothing reads any more, `hkb doctor --api`'s lock-ref probe (replaced by `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` + WAL + mount).
2. The forge half (`src/forge.js`, still on `src/gh.js`): the worker brief (`src/context.js`) stops writing `Closes #n` and instead names the branch `kb-<id>-<k>` as the link; the `active_pr` guard and the reconcile pass tie a PR to its card by head branch (`branchFallbackPrs` becomes the only path; a merged PR found by `GET pulls?state=closed&head=…` marks the card `done`); `hkb merge` (`mergeCard`) sets `done` itself after the merge; `finishPr`'s un-draft and reviewer request stay.
3. `test/fake-gh.js` shrinks to the forge routes (pulls, merge, protection, rules, auto-merge); every remaining test runs on `test/fake-store.js` (C1).
4. Docs: `README.md` "How it works" and "How it maps to GitHub" rewritten for the local store (issues are no longer the board); `skills/kanban/references/protocol.md` loses the GitHub-isms (labels, refs, comments as the record) and gains the two tiers; `CLAUDE.md` "Rules" bullet about `gh.js`/`tasks.js`/`lock.js` rewritten; the wiki pages that describe the GitHub store (`architecture/overview.md`, `concepts/worker-identity.md`, `features/review-loop.md`, `features/auto-merge.md`) refreshed.

## Done when
- [ ] `grep -rn "Closes #" src skills` returns nothing; `grep -rn "kb:status\|kb:agent\|refs/kb/locks" src` returns nothing outside `src/init.js`'s import path.
- [ ] A PR merged on a scratch repo (use the forge double) moves its card to `done` on the next tick; `hkb merge` does the same immediately.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green; `wiki-check` reports nothing stale for the pages named.

## Contract
Do not migrate this repository's own board in this card (the root does it, after the code has landed). Keep `src/gh.js` and the forge functions' names.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: src/store/github.js is deleted; no worker brief writes Closes #n; a PR is tied to its card by the kb-<id>-<k> branch name; a merged PR marks its card done through the listing by head branch; hkb merge sets done; KB_LOCK_REF, lock_sha, the comment-mode heartbeat and the run-comment format are gone; fake-gh holds only forge routes
title: Retire the GitHub store; the forge half without issues
